stories.title: Ethereum clients ship security fixes, but binary users need a separate Java check
stories.summary: Ethereum client teams released security fixes. Users who run binary installations, not Java-based builds, must do a separate check to confirm they have the patch. CryptoSlate's report does not state the vulnerability's severity or name every affected client.
stories.whyItMatters: Node operators who miss the check may run unpatched software, which puts network security and their own funds at risk.
whatToWatch: A fuller vulnerability disclosure from the client teams
Confirmation of which Ethereum clients are affected
questions: How many node operators remain unpatched?

sources.title: Ethereum client security fixes leave binary users with a separate Java check

stories.title: Ethena Pay's 11x leverage loop offers high yield, but can hide losses
stories.summary: Ethena Pay offers a leverage loop with exposure up to 11x and promises high yield. CryptoSlate reports the structure can hide losses that surface only later. The report gives no figures on current adoption or past performance.
stories.whyItMatters: High-leverage DeFi products have caused cascading losses before, so hidden risk in a yield product matters to anyone chasing returns in crypto.
whatToWatch: Any loss or liquidation reports tied to Ethena Pay
Responses from Ethena or other protocols on leveraged yield risk
questions: What exactly triggers the hidden losses the report flags?

sources.title: Ethena Pay’s 11x leverage loop promises high yield, but risks hidden losses

stories.title: Euro-area banks report record deterioration in retail-funding access
stories.summary: Euro-area banks reported a record deterioration in retail-funding access, CryptoSlate reports. The report does not name the underlying survey or give specific figures beyond this top-line finding.
stories.whyItMatters: Weak retail-funding conditions at banks can push savers and institutions toward alternative assets, including crypto, as traditional banking tightens.
whatToWatch: Follow-up data from euro-area banking surveys
Any shift in retail deposit or investment flows that follows
questions: What is driving the funding deterioration?
Which banks or countries are most affected?

stories.title: Robinhood posts record $1.4 billion revenue, but a 14% profit drop reveals portfolio losses
stories.summary: Robinhood reported record quarterly revenue of $1.4 billion, yet profit fell 14%, a drop that CryptoSlate says exposes hidden portfolio losses. A related CryptoSlate report says Robinhood now earns more from prediction markets than from crypto trading.
stories.whyItMatters: Robinhood is a major retail on-ramp to crypto, so a revenue mix shift away from crypto trading signals changing retail interest.
whatToWatch: Robinhood's next earnings report for the crypto-versus-prediction-market revenue trend
More detail on what drove the portfolio losses
questions: What specifically caused the hidden portfolio losses?
How much of Robinhood's revenue now comes from prediction markets?

Robinhood now makes more money from predicting the future than trading crypto

stories.title: Bitcoin option buyers pay a Fed-week premium that can fade after the decision
stories.summary: Bitcoin options carry an elevated premium ahead of this week's Federal Reserve decision, CryptoSlate reports. That premium has tended to fade once the decision is announced, a pattern seen around past Fed meetings.
stories.whyItMatters: Options pricing around Fed meetings shows how much macro policy, rather than crypto-specific news, now drives bitcoin's volatility expectations.
whatToWatch: The Fed's rate decision this week
Bitcoin options pricing right after the announcement
questions: How large is the current premium compared to past Fed weeks?

sources.title: Bitcoin option buyers face a Fed-week premium that can fade after the decision

stories.title: Coinbase says it wasn't breached, but hackers don't need to steal crypto to hurt users
stories.summary: Coinbase said it was not breached, CryptoSlate reports, but the report notes attackers do not need direct access to crypto holdings to harm users. The report gives no further detail on the specific incident or attack method.
stories.whyItMatters: Exchange-adjacent attacks, such as phishing, can hurt users and erode trust even without a direct hack of exchange systems.
whatToWatch: Whether Coinbase discloses more about the incident behind the statement
questions: What method did hackers use if not a direct breach?

sources.title: Coinbase says it wasn’t breached, but hackers don’t need to steal crypto to hurt users

stories.title: Polymarket built a $14 billion US trading business almost entirely on sports bets
stories.summary: Polymarket has built a $14 billion US trading business, CryptoSlate reports, with sports bets making up almost all of it. The finding shows the platform's US growth leans heavily on sports wagering, not political or other event markets.
stories.whyItMatters: Polymarket's sports-driven growth tests how a crypto-based prediction market fits into US sports-betting and gambling rules.
whatToWatch: US regulatory response to Polymarket's sports-betting volume
Whether Polymarket grows volume outside sports markets
questions: How does this volume compare to licensed US sportsbooks?
What regulatory scrutiny applies to crypto-based sports betting?

sources.title: Polymarket built a $14 billion US trading business almost entirely on sports bets

stories.title: Galaxy's AI data centers bring in $79 million in lease revenue, with a small net loss
stories.summary: Galaxy reported $79 million in lease revenue from its AI data center business, CryptoSlate reports, alongside a small net loss for the period. The result reflects Galaxy's push to diversify from crypto trading into AI infrastructure.
stories.whyItMatters: A crypto-native firm's move into AI infrastructure shows how some companies hedge against crypto market cycles with other revenue.
whatToWatch: Galaxy's future earnings for data center revenue growth
Whether the net loss narrows as the AI business scales
questions: What drove the net loss despite the lease revenue?
How large is Galaxy's total AI infrastructure investment?

stories.title: Kraken to cancel orders across 176 crypto markets in sweeping trading overhaul
stories.summary: Kraken plans to cancel outstanding orders across 176 crypto markets as part of a broad trading overhaul, CryptoSlate reports. The report does not give the overhaul's full scope or timeline beyond the order cancellations.
stories.whyItMatters: Traders with open orders on the affected markets need to act, and the scale of the change points to a major shift in Kraken's trading infrastructure.
whatToWatch: The date Kraken cancels the orders
Further detail on what the trading overhaul changes
questions: Why is Kraken canceling orders across so many markets at once?
Will affected users need to resubmit orders manually?

sources.title: Kraken to cancel orders across 176 crypto markets in sweeping trading overhaul
